# miscale

macOS CLI for the Xiaomi Mi Body Composition Scale 2 (XMTZC05HM). Reproduces Zepp Life 6.16.1 scale features locally: live weighing, body composition (bit-exact port of libBodyfat.so), offline history sync, family members, guest, infant and balance modes, scale settings.

## Installation

```bash
make build
```

## Quick Usage

```bash
miscale user add --name me --sex m --birth 1987-04 --height 181 --weight 97
miscale sync    # once: registers the history key, offline records are kept from then on
miscale measure
miscale sync
miscale history
miscale -f json show 1
miscale scale info
```

## Output

Markdown tables by default, JSON with `-f json`. Progress and prompts go to stderr.

## Data

`~/Library/Application Support/miscale/data.json`, override with `--data` or `MISCALE_DATA`.
